from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityCDSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One university's Common Data Set record with enrollment and graduation rate."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The university or institution name as named in the document")
    total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students enrollment from Section B1")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort as a percentage from Section B4-B21")
    cohort_year: str = Field(description="The cohort year for the graduation rate data", default="2015")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityCDSRecord]
